cases.sentence: Я разгромил мощную руку фараона, царя ___.
cases.translation: I have broken the arm of Pharaoh, king of Egypt.
cases.explain: Genitive case in possessive construction expresses the relationship of king to Egypt.

cases.sentence: Ее не перевязали, чтобы исцелить, и не наложили ___.
cases.translation: To apply medicines, to put a bandage.
cases.explain: The transitive verb наложили requires accusative case for its direct object.

cases.translation: I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt.
cases.explain: Genitive case in possessive construction: царю Египта (king of Egypt).

cases.sentence: Я сломаю ему обе руки, так что он уронит свой ___.
cases.translation: So that he will drop his sword.
cases.explain: The transitive verb уронит requires accusative case for direct object.

cases.sentence: Я рассею египтян среди других народов и развею их по чужим ___.
cases.translation: I will scatter the Egyptians among other nations and disperse them through foreign lands.
cases.explain: The preposition по (through/by) with spatial extent governs dative case.

cases.sentence: Я укреплю мышцы Вавилонского царя и вложу мой меч в его ___.
cases.translation: I will put my sword in his hand.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with motion requires accusative case.

cases.sentence: А мышцы фараона разорву, и он будет стонать перед царем ___.
cases.translation: He will groan before the king of Babylon.
cases.explain: Genitive case in possessive construction: царем Вавилона (king of Babylon).

cases.sentence: Когда я вложу мой меч в руку царя Вавилона, и он занесет его над ___.
cases.translation: He will stretch it out over Egypt.
cases.explain: The preposition над (over) with direction requires accusative case.

reading.ru: Я разгромил мощную руку фараона, царя Египта, и ее не перевязали, чтобы исцелить.
reading.question: What has God already done to Pharaoh?
options: Broken his mighty arm without healing
reading.correct: Broken his mighty arm without healing
reading.explain: God declares He has already broken Pharaoh's arm and it was not healed or bandaged.

reading.ru: Поэтому так говорит владыка Господь. Я враг фараону, царю Египта. Я сломаю ему обе руки.
reading.question: What is God's intention toward Pharaoh?
options: To break both his arms, showing complete power over him
reading.correct: To break both his arms, showing complete power over him
reading.explain: God declares Himself as an enemy who will break both Pharaoh's arms completely.

reading.ru: Я рассею египтян среди других народов и развею их по чужим землям.
reading.question: What will become of the Egyptian people?
options: They will be scattered among nations and dispersed to foreign lands
They will remain united in Egypt
They will become the greatest power
reading.correct: They will be scattered among nations and dispersed to foreign lands
reading.explain: God describes the complete diaspora of the Egyptian people across foreign lands.

reading.ru: Я укреплю мышцы Вавилонского царя и вложу мой меч в его руку.
reading.question: How will God demonstrate His power?
options: By strengthening Babylon's king and putting His sword in his hand
reading.correct: By strengthening Babylon's king and putting His sword in his hand
reading.explain: God will empower Babylon as His instrument of judgment against Egypt.

reading.ru: А мышцы фараона разорву, и он будет стонать перед царем Вавилона, словно смертельно раненый.
reading.question: What will be Pharaoh's condition before Babylon's king?
options: He will be broken and groan like a mortally wounded man
reading.correct: He will be broken and groan like a mortally wounded man
reading.explain: Pharaoh will be completely broken and will cry out like someone who is dying.

reading.ru: Они узнают, что я Господь, когда я вложу мой меч в руку царя Вавилона, и он занесет его над Египтом.
reading.question: How will nations come to know God's identity and power?
options: Through God putting His sword in Babylon's hand and he stretches it against Egypt
reading.correct: Through God putting His sword in Babylon's hand and he stretches it against Egypt
reading.explain: God's sovereignty and power will be revealed through the judgment executed by Babylon against Egypt.
